# A book with a `company` block and no accounts at all.
#
# No `base_currency:` is given and there is no top-level account to share a
# currency, so the book's currency is refused (Q-042).
#
# What this fixture produces: the company's name, and nothing else.
# Imported with --include-business-objects.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_currency_a_book_is_kept_in.py.
company
  name: "A Company With No Accounts"
